recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一大團彼此融合、邊界不清的合胞體樣細胞團，內含約二十多個橢圓形、染色質均勻深染的細胞核，細胞質豐富深藍紫色；周圍是血液、脂肪空泡與零星小型造血細胞，這種黏聚性的外來細胞團提示轉移性癌。
features: Large cohesive syncytial aggregate of non-hematopoietic cells with indistinct cell borders
About two dozen oval to round nuclei with evenly dense chromatin, smooth contours and mild crowding/overlap
Abundant, deeply basophilic to violet cytoplasm forming a continuous sheet with an irregular outline
Background of red cells, fat vacuoles and sparse small hematopoietic cells (lymphocytes/erythroid precursors)
A second, smaller cytoplasmic fragment at lower right; nucleoli and mucin vacuoles not clearly resolved at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive syncytial aggregate of atypical cells with oval, crowded nuclei, evenly dense chromatin and abundant basophilic cytoplasm, set in a background of blood, fat vacuoles and sparse hematopoietic cells. The cluster is clearly foreign to normal marrow elements. Fine nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma infiltrating the marrow, correlating with poorly differentiated mucin-producing adenocarcinoma on biopsy and the clinical picture of myelophthisis.

ddx.vs: An osteoclast is a single giant cell with many uniform, well-separated round nuclei with nucleoli and granular pink-purple cytoplasm, whereas here nuclei overlap and are crowded in a basophilic syncytium.
Megakaryocytes have one large multilobated nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm and budding platelets, not multiple discrete oval nuclei.
Osteoblasts show eccentric nuclei with a pale Golgi zone separated from the nucleus and form loose comet-like groups rather than a tight syncytium.
Stromal fragments contain elongated spindle nuclei within a fibrillary pink matrix rather than oval epithelioid nuclei in dense basophilic cytoplasm.
